def find_min_d(x_sequence, target=1810):
    """
    Calculates the minimum distance |Sum(I) - target| over all subsets I.
    """
    n = len(x_sequence)
    min_d = float('inf')
    
    # Iterate through all 2^n subsets
    for i in range(1 << n):
        current_sum = 0
        for j in range(n):
            # Check if j-th element is in the subset (j-th bit is set in i)
            if (i >> j) & 1:
                current_sum += x_sequence[j]
        
        distance = abs(current_sum - target)
        min_d = min(min_d, distance)
        
    return min_d
